title: Tales of Arise item and equipment catalog
description: English factual names and broad categories for the base-game PS5 schema. Keys are catalog identities; they do not authorize save construction or replacement.

attribution.author: Aselia Wiki contributors
attribution.modifications: Names and broad item categories transcribed into the toolkit record format; no guide prose or artwork included. Numeric IDs 1-13 are independently observed in the PS5 sample corpus.

attribution.author: Aselia Wiki contributors
attribution.modifications: A small name-only starter subset grouped by playable character; symbolic catalog keys are deliberately not claimed to be PS5 serialized IDs.
